---
title: "Eten en scherm gebruik vs Gemiddelde Hartslag — Analyse"
author: "Mohammed"
output: html_document
---

# 1. Libraries laden

```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
```

# 2. Data inladen & voorbereiden

```{r data-laden, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- read_csv("../data/combined_data/combined_data.csv")
data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data <- drop_na(data, last_food, time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours, time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours, average_sleep_heart_rate)
```

# 3. Statistieken

```{r statistieken}
analyse_data <- data
analyse_data %>%
  group_by(naam) %>%
  summarise(
    gem_slaap_hartslag   = round(mean(average_sleep_heart_rate), 2),
    sd_slaap_hartslag    = round(sd(average_sleep_heart_rate), 2),
    gem_uren_na_eten     = round(mean(time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours), 2),
    sd_uren_na_eten      = round(sd(time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours), 2),
    gem_uren_na_scherm   = round(mean(time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours), 2),
    sd_uren_na_scherm    = round(sd(time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours), 2)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

# 4. Kleuren instellen

```{r kleuren}
groeps_kleuren <- c("Robin" = "#F8766D",
                    "Lucas" = "#00BA38",
                    "Mohammed" = "#619CFF")
```

## 5. Analyse A — Eten-timing vs Gemiddelde Hartslag tijdens Slaap

### Correlatie

```{r cor-hartslag-eten}
analyse_data %>%
  group_by(naam) %>%
  summarise(
    R2 = round(summary(lm(average_sleep_heart_rate ~ time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours))$r.squared, 3),
    p  = round(cor.test(time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours, average_sleep_heart_rate)$p.value, 3)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

### Plot — alle personen vergeleken

```{r plot-hartslag-combined, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(data, aes(x = time_between_last_food_and_sleep_hours, y = average_sleep_heart_rate,
                          color = naam, fill = naam)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = groeps_kleuren, name = "Persoon") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = groeps_kleuren, name = "Persoon") +
  labs(
    title = "Alle personen — Uren tussen laatste maaltijd en slaap vs Gemiddelde Hartslag",
    x     = "Aantal uren tussen eten en slapen",
    y     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag tijdens Slaap (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 6. Analyse B — Schermgebruik vs Gemiddelde hartslag tijdens slaap

### Correlatie

```{r cor-hartslag-scherm}
analyse_data %>%
  group_by(naam) %>%
  summarise(
    R2 = round(summary(lm(average_sleep_heart_rate ~ time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours))$r.squared, 3),
    p  = round(cor.test(time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours, average_sleep_heart_rate)$p.value, 3)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

### Plot — alle personen vergeleken

```{r plot-scherm-combined, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(data, aes(x = time_between_phone_used_and_sleep_hours, y = average_sleep_heart_rate,
                          color = naam, fill = naam)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = groeps_kleuren, name = "Persoon") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = groeps_kleuren, name = "Persoon") +
  labs(
    title = "Alle personen — Uren tussen telefoongebruik en slaap vs Gemiddelde Hartslag",
    x     = "Aantal uren van telefoongebruik voor het slapen",
    y     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag tijdens Slaap (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
